language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hi. I am Bob. I am a baseball coach and I have just taken over coaching assignment for a local school team.
I need some help! you see, I am not really good with numbers, especially fractions.
Let me show you just how I struggle with fractions!
Let’s take for example fraction 1/3.
Let’s try to find fractions equal in value to 1/3... How should I go about this?
Aahh! Hmmm!... Well! Let's multiply both numerator and denominator by 2.
That would give me 2/6, which is... equal in value to 1/3.
Bingo! I’ve got it!
Whenever I would multiply numerator and denominator of a fraction by the same number I would get fractions equal in value to original fraction.
So 3/9, 4/12, 5/15, etc etc all are equal in value to 1/3!
Yes, I’ve figured out that will all buy myself!
Can you help me with some other calculations today? You can join me in the evening practice
if you want – that’s a freebie i just give that to you.
